proxyEnable.title: Enable proxy
proxyEnable.desc: Used to fetch GitHub and other sources for the plugin marketplace (registry / plugin downloads). Only affects plugin fetching; other traffic connects directly.

proxyUrl.title: Proxy address
proxyUrl.desc: Format: http://ip:port, https://ip:port or socks5://ip:port, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:7890 or socks5://127.0.0.1:1080

batchPace.title: Batch task pace
batchPace.desc: Controls CPU usage and speed of batch tasks such as playlist sync / online matching / recommendation backfill. Low is most CPU-friendly (recommended while the computer is in use); Full is fastest but heavier.
batchPace.hintStandard: Concurrency 2, 120ms batch sleep, auto-degrades when busy
batchPace.hintFull: Concurrency 4, no batch sleep, fastest but heavier

dailySync.title: Daily scheduled sync
dailySync.desc: Master switch: runs the full daily pipeline (recommendations / charts / playlist sync) at the set time. Whether each plugin participates is decided by its «Participate in daily sync» switch on the plugin config page (all on by default).

dailyTime.title: Execution time
dailyTime.desc: Runs once at this time every day (originally fixed 03:00; now configurable to the minute). Takes effect immediately.

memoryReclaim.title: Idle memory reclamation
memoryReclaim.autoDesc: After a period with no playback activity and no playlist fetch/import/sync/scan operations, automatically clears rebuildable caches (library index / covers / lyrics, etc.) to reclaim memory.
memoryReclaim.idleDesc: Minutes of inactivity before reclamation is triggered.

flows.title: Flows
flows.tip: A flow is a repeatable auto-play pipeline built from ordered nodes (like Node-RED): trigger, target device/group, content, playback mode, volume, delay. Nodes can be drag-sorted, inserted anywhere, and duplicated; they are triggered externally via the External link (Webhook) or manually via Run on this page. The old fixed configuration is obsolete — please rebuild your node flow.

flows.triggered: Triggered; the background is now continuously scanning devices
flows.editorTip: Nodes run in order; drag to reorder, insert anywhere; manual Run is always available

flows.whNoteReady: The link already contains the bound private token; do not share it publicly. Manual trigger always works.

flows.ctlTip: Independent of flows: the URL parameters below are the configuration; they directly control online DLNA speakers / player groups without any internal flow. Parameters can be edited by hand and reused, and multiple actions can be chained in one request. The flow's external link also reuses these channel tokens for authentication.
flows.newTokenPh: New token name, e.g. living-room speaker / temporary access…
flows.tokensNote: Notes: each token is independently valid. Disabling = old links immediately return 403; deleting = links permanently invalid (401/404). Favorites are attributed to each token's creator. A flow bound to this token has its external link take effect / become invalid immediately.
